about: Every file the Ferrata LEZ test network's host serves from the repository, with its SHA-256 and the commit it comes from. Check it with `python3 -I scripts/site-manifest.py verify` from a clone. A file whose commit is not public ("public": false) can be checked against this manifest but not yet against its source.
made_how: the host's file list of 23 November 2026, 14:54 UTC (sha256sum of its web root), each path re-hashed over HTTPS at 2026-11-23T22:43Z, plus the basecamp page's bundle and this branch's pages as they are to be deployed; a fresh list could not be read (the deploy account's session had expired), so files the host gained since 14:54 outside those two bundles are not listed. Re-pinned on 24 November 2026 to this repository's public history (main): the trust pages and the Basecamp bundle as this tree has them; files the host served from commits that are not in public history are listed as unmatched until the next deploy
